Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT bs."in.county_name" AS county_name, bs."in.geometry_building_type_recs" AS geometry_building_type_recs, sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption" * bs.weight) AS "electricity.total.energy_consumption" FROM resstock_2024_amy2018_release_2_metadata AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs.bldg_id IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id FROM resstock_2024_amy2018_release_2_metadata AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1, 16) AND bs.applicability = true GROUP BY bs.bldg_id) AND bs."in.state" = 'CO' AND bs.bldg_id IN (13, 16, 33, 196, 5224, 7321, 7923, 12142) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/27a0b3d2b0478e801ee36fadee67e6955b28a2b25dd3a7784cc4771813eac023/00db321f-6bf5-4e18-a20c-086ab897e8b1/'
